scope: Independent bundled analysis, explicit CPU mapping and authored opcode fixtures; isolation from actual loaded emulator, APU, original ROM, active project, undo/redo and recorded history. VM DOM, not browser or hardware acceptance.

results.name: Every protected navigation baseline source survives the exact audio correction, release and recovery-label edits
Unknown engine and unsupported mapper are inspectable beside a populated emulator and recorded history
Authentic Bridge Room recovery refusal leaves a general analysis and original emulator intact
NROM mirror aliases have distinct branch destinations while every row retains its physical file offset
Independent opcode bytes decode addressing and endian order without inventing indirect jump targets
Relative branches wrap CPU addresses while user mappings never silently cross the address space
Physical search resumes across chunk and overlapping-pattern boundaries without omitted matches
ROM identity and readable bytes remain fixed even when callers mutate input during hashing
Malformed container declarations retain every original byte and do not manufacture banks or vectors
Actual analysis UI opens unknown mapper, maps banks, searches and labels without replacing emulator or authoring state
New raw file owns fresh mappings and annotations while an older pending file cannot publish over it
A canceled asynchronous search cannot append stale matches after another file opens
Inspection exports identify user evidence and reject project import without dropping active work
